csv-to-excel.workedExample:
Input CSV (3 rows, 3 columns):
name,age,city
Aarav Sharma,25,Mumbai
Priya Verma,30,Delhi

The tool detects the comma delimiter, parses 3 rows and 3 columns, and writes Sheet1 with:
- A1=name, B1=age, C1=city (text cells)
- A2=Aarav Sharma (text), B2=25 (numeric), C2=Mumbai (text)
- A3=Priya Verma (text), B3=30 (numeric), C3=Delhi (text)

The downloaded data.xlsx opens in Excel with sortable numeric ages.
